t: Listen to an announcement on a university radio station.
Due to unforeseen circumstances, the appearance of Georgia Linton has been postponed.
The event will now take place next Tuesday at seven p.m. in the same location.
Come hear her read from her widely acclaimed collection of poems called Seasons That Never Spoke.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding.
If you have any questions, please contact the head of the English Department.
